title: Lawn parties, no singing, only chords
summary: Lawn parties and truck rides; he did not sing or play rags, only chords.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves

blocks.x: Did you play any lawn parties here? Lawn parties?

Uh huh. Yeah we used to play all that. Long parties and I. Truck rides all like that. Yeah. All them things. Did you sing with the bands much? Uh huh. Did you sing with the bands? Did you sing with the bands?
Did you sing? Sing? No. I never, Charlie sing, not me I couldn't sing.
Did you sing any, I mean did you play any rags?
Honestly, I only played, I only played cards like I told you. That's all I done played chords. Oh yeah.
